enrichCreatorByEmail.name: enrichCreatorByEmail
enrichCreatorByEmail.description: Enrich creator data by email address with advanced mode including all social medias and full profile stats

email.description: The email address of the creator to enrich

aiMetadata.description: Look up and enrich a creator/influencer profile from a known email address, returning their connected social accounts and profile stats. Choose this when you have an email and want the matching creator data; use the by-handle action instead when you only have a social handle. Optionally filter results by minimum follower count or exclude specific platforms. This is a read-only lookup and is idempotent.

enrichCreatorByHandle.name: enrichCreatorByHandle
enrichCreatorByHandle.displayName: Enrich Creator Social Profile by Handle
enrichCreatorByHandle.description: Enrich creator data by social media handle with full mode including all connected platforms and detailed stats

handle.description: The social media handle of the creator

platform.description: The social media platform for the handle

include_lookalikes.description: Include similar creators for faster discovery (30-40% quicker). Default: true

email_required.description: Controls how to handle email availability

options.label: Preferred (return data even if no email found)
Must Have (only return if valid email exists)

aiMetadata.description: Look up and enrich a creator/influencer profile from a social media handle plus the platform it belongs to (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter/X, Twitch, or OnlyFans), returning their connected platforms and detailed stats. Choose this when you have a handle rather than an email; use the by-email action when you only have an email. The platform is required, and you can require a valid email be present (must_have) or accept partial data (preferred). This is a read-only lookup and is idempotent.

findSimilarCreator.name: findSimilarCreator
findSimilarCreator.description: Find creators similar to a given creator handle or profile URL with optional filters

filter_key.description: The type of identifier for the creator

filter_value.description: Platform URL, profile handle, or user ID

limit.description: Maximum number of similar creators to return (min: 1, max: 50)

number_of_followers.description: Filter by follower count (min and max)

engagement_percent.description: Filter by engagement rate (min and max)

aiMetadata.description: Discover creators/influencers similar to a seed creator on a given platform, identifying that seed by URL, username, or platform user ID (set via the filter key). Choose this for lookalike discovery once you have a reference creator. Optionally narrow results by follower-count range, engagement-rate range, verified-only, or excluding private profiles, and cap the result count (1-50). This is a read-only search and is idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
